entities.summary: Bruno of Augsburg von Bayern was the son of Henry II, Duke of Bavaria and Gisela of Burgundy. He was the younger brother of Henry II, Holy Roman Emperor of Germany, the only Holy Roman Emperor to be made a saint. He and his brother were tutored by Wolfgang of Regensburg.
